== Published English Original Virtual Set 5 wording ==
The original slip and the [[:File:Dagobah-D-precisiontargeting-decipher-archive.gif|Decipher base card]] have no title dot. The remastered slip prints a dot. The period rule ordinarily retains the restriction of the underlying card. The later single weapon pull names your deploy phase, where the general deployment and One Rule rules govern the action.
